description: This Python source file implements an audio filter class called KoalaFilter that utilizes the PicoVoice Koala engine for noise suppression in audio streams. The class manages initialization, processing audio frames, enabling/disabling filtering, and buffering audio data for real-time noise reduction.

classes.name: KoalaFilter
classes.description: An audio filter class that applies PicoVoice's Koala noise suppression engine to audio streams, providing real-time background noise reduction.

methods.name: None __init__(self, *, access_key: str)
methods.description: Initializes the KoalaFilter with an access key for PicoVoice's Koala engine, setting up internal state and buffers.

methods.name: start(self, sample_rate: int)
methods.description: Configures the filter with the sample rate of incoming audio; checks for compatibility with the Koala engine.

methods.name: stop(self)
methods.description: Resets the Koala engine, performing cleanup when stopping the filter.

methods.name: process_frame(self, frame: FilterControlFrame)
methods.description: Handles control frames to enable or disable the filtering dynamically.

methods.name: bytes filter(self, audio: bytes)
methods.description: Processes incoming audio bytes, buffers them, and applies noise suppression using the Koala engine, returning the filtered audio.
